mapper.select: select org.uuid as "organizationUuid", org.ip_allowlist_applies_to_admins as "appliesToAdmins", r.cidr as "cidr" from organizations org left join cs_ip_allowlist_range r on r.organization_uuid = org.uuid where org.ip_allowlist_enabled = ${_true}
select r.cidr from cs_ip_allowlist_range r where r.organization_uuid = #{organizationUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by r.cidr
